standard: A candidate must have a coherent central claim, exact evidence, executable certificates, a stated novelty boundary and a route to expert-facing exposition. Paper-worthy does not mean submission-ready or externally validated.

candidates.title: Furey matter as a ternary operator system: anomaly classification, Kantor obstruction and classical structurable closure
candidates.central_claim: The completed Furey matter rectangles form exact TROs with a sharply classified anomaly-free subset; the raw ordered product is not Kantor, its canonical structurable repair has classical five-graded closure, and the physically motivated CP graph does not preserve the Spin(2,3) Kantor slice.
candidates.novelty_boundary: General TRO, structurable and Kantor theory is established literature; the potentially new content is the exhaustive application to this specific Furey Standard-Model carrier and the combined anomaly/CP obstruction.
candidates.missing_before_submission: Independent reproduction, a conventional mathematical proof replacing certificate-only steps, and a systematic literature review beyond targeted searches.

candidates.title: Two-current Standard-Model response versus the topology-first Jordan carrier
candidates.verdict: paper-worthy only after one renormalized correlator calculation
candidates.central_claim: A controlled source action and vacuum QFT axioms yield an H2(R)+ spectral carrier generically, while an exact affine frame torsor and route-separation theorem show why this does not identify the Furey topology carrier.
candidates.novelty_boundary: Spectral positivity and matrix Herglotz theory are standard; the potentially publishable content is the explicit programme-specific source construction, normalization ledger and no-identification theorem.
candidates.missing_before_submission: At least leading interacting operator mixing and one explicit renormalized correlator or OPE calculation.

candidates.title: Freudenthal inverse graphs and the scale-selection no-go
candidates.verdict: possible focused mathematical note, subject to novelty review
candidates.central_claim: On the paired H2(R) space, the inverse-matched graph is the positive quartic critical locus, while homogeneous exceptional data and log-determinant actions cannot intrinsically select its scale, embedding or orientation.
candidates.novelty_boundary: Freudenthal quartics and Jordan adjoints are classical; novelty would have to lie in the exact paired-source restriction and its selector no-go, not in the underlying identities.
candidates.missing_before_submission: Comparison with the specialist Freudenthal/Jordan literature and a coordinate-free proof clarifying whether the critical-locus statement is already implicit in known rank stratifications.

candidates.title: A falsifiability and type-safety audit of algebraic Standard-Model reconstruction
candidates.verdict: potential perspective or methods paper, not a fundamental-physics result by itself
candidates.central_claim: A machine-checked dependency graph exposes where representation availability is repeatedly mistaken for action-level selection or observable prediction across Lie, Jordan, Freudenthal and Kantor routes.
candidates.novelty_boundary: The scientific value is methodological consolidation and explicit counterexamples; it must not claim that machine assistance or document volume establishes physics.
candidates.missing_before_submission: Compression to a small set of independently readable theorems, expert co-authorship or review, and removal of programme-internal terminology.

candidates.title: A reduced-rank, scale-free test of restricted ultraviolet ALP charge patterns
candidates.verdict: paper-shaped phenomenology study after a nuisance-profiled likelihood; not yet a derivation paper
candidates.central_claim: Rare-meson production times proper lifetime removes the common ALP scale and can test a restricted top-lepton charge relation, while a local identifiability calculation reduces eight ultraviolet coefficients to five physical low-energy coordinates and shows that present production-plus-lifetime data practically resolve only three or four.
candidates.novelty_boundary: ALP running, rare-meson constraints and bottomonium searches are established; potential programme value lies in the combined scale-free discriminator, explicit experimental-rank audit and honest separation between a derived incidence kernel and an underived exact charge ray.
candidates.missing_before_submission: A full nuisance-profiled likelihood using experiment-level acceptance or likelihood information, a systematic comparison with existing ALP benchmark analyses, and either an algebraic metric selecting the incidence normalization or an explicitly restricted benchmark claim.
